# docs.paypal.ai documentation — Growth — Disputes

> 9 page(s) of docs.paypal.ai documentation — Growth under Disputes. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Disputes

- [Choose integration option](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/disputes/choose-integration-option.md): PayPal's dispute management provides two integration options to help you manage disputes seamlessly.
- [Use Disputes API](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/disputes/handle-disputes/use-disputes-api.md): You can use the PayPal Disputes API to handle and resolve disputes programmatically throughout their lifecycle.
- [Use Resolution Center](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/disputes/handle-disputes/use-resolution-center.md): You can use the PayPal Resolution Center to manually view, respond, and resolve disputes for your PayPal business account.
- [Overview](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/disputes/overview.md): A dispute or chargeback occurs when a buyer reports an issue with their transaction, such as non-receipt of an item, receiving an item significantly different from its…
- [Dispute reasons and evidence](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/disputes/reference/dispute-reasons.md): You can determine what evidence to provide for a dispute or chargeback based on its reason.
- [Disputes API - test values for simulations](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/disputes/reference/disputes-api-test-values.md): Developers and QA engineers can use these predefined test values to simulate negative Disputes API responses in a sandbox while they develop and test their integration.
- [Supported file types and sizes](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/disputes/reference/supported-file-types-sizes.md): When handling disputes, you can upload supporting files as evidence to strengthen your case.
- [Set up accounts and environment](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/disputes/set-up.md): Use these procedures to configure your PayPal business and sandbox accounts to manage disputes in the Resolution Center or to integrate with the Disputes API.
- [Test and go live](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/disputes/test-go-live.md): Implement and validate the PayPal Disputes API in sandbox and live environments as a developer or QA engineer.
